name: Pension Fischbacher
beschreibung:
History

The website pension-fischbacher.at presents the Pension Fischbacher as a house in the centre of Walchsee in the Kaiserwinkl. Clara Fischbacher cooks in the evening and is named as a personal adviser for the stay. A founding history or a year of construction is not published on the page retrieved. The address is Alleestraße 16, 6344 Walchsee, telephone and fax +43 5374 5276, email info@pension-fischbacher.at. Older sentences that place the house “in the centre of Tirol” or claim a modern alpine design language do not stand as such on the page. Walchsee lies in the Kaiserwinkl.

Getting there

The contact page repeats Alleestraße 16, 6344 Walchsee. A description of train, bus or parking spaces is not on the pages retrieved. Enquiries go through the form or the telephone. The house describes the location as the centre of the village.

Tips

There are 27 double rooms in Tyrolean style, each with cable television, a bathroom with shower and WC, a hairdryer on request, a safe, a seating corner and a balcony with a view of the mountains. According to the homepage, the breakfast buffet always includes a home-baked Zopf. In the evening Clara Fischbacher cooks Austrian home cooking. The price page separates the seasons. Summer 2026, May to October: double room including breakfast, the parenthesis also naming breakfast buffet and a 3-course evening menu, from 65 to 85 euros. Winter 2026/27, December to April: from 68 to 85 euros. The page writes that rooms are also available with breakfast only. The prices are per person, without the local tax of 2.60 euros per person per night. A short stay costs 7 euros extra per person per night. A double room for single use costs 14 euros extra per night. Whether the range named means half board or only breakfast is not entirely unambiguous on the page because of the parenthesis and should be asked when booking.
kurzbeschreibung: Pension Fischbacher of Clara Fischbacher, Alleestraße 16 in the centre of Walchsee, with 27 double rooms, breakfast and an evening menu on request.
